The Necklace Of Charm sets your Charisma stat to 18 (+4) while worn.

GMs: Hand the Necklace Of Charm to the party's charisma-challenged member; their Charisma becomes 18, no questions asked.

Save this for your next session. Daily rulings: @bizzalgames70

Light tone, real consequences: build the scene around Adult Blue Dragon and table overconfidence.

DMs: Use the dragon's 80-foot fly speed to exploit players' poor positioning; force them to respect its mobility or suffer.

Bookmark it before your players find the loophole. @bizzalgames70

Yes, Kaundyuk looks harmless - until the table underestimates it and gives it free turns.

Players: laugh first, then respect turn economy before this joke encounter snowballs.

Difficulty Class determines success or failure with a single roll.

GMs: Establish intent, trigger, and outcome before rolling against DC 12 to avoid pointless arguments.
